story.title: Luxury is not loud. It lingers.

ritual.title: A few moments of ritual. Hours of atmosphere.
ritual.text: Bukhoor is deliberately unhurried. Prepare the burner, place a small amount, then let the fragrance move naturally through the room.
ritual.safety: Always use a heat-safe burner on a stable surface and never leave burning charcoal unattended.
